mode: Real React components, CSS, PDF.js rendering; synthetic HTTP contracts, permissions and Next Link
checks: Private endpoint is used and real PDF.js renders a page
Desktop panels scroll independently and header actions remain accessible
PDF zoom renders at the chosen scale
PDF page navigation respects the page count
Section navigation moves keyboard focus to the selected section
Detail navigation renders complete sections without runtime crashes
Basic edit uses M2 revision endpoint and submits only the chosen field
Conflicting revision keeps the unsaved field and explains recovery
Failed reload retains drafts and blocks saving against stale data
Reload preserves the conflicting draft
Review completion is disabled while drafts remain
Header saves only pending field corrections
Partial verification is displayed without verifying unrelated fields
Review completion submits only its workflow flag and revision
Header batches drafts across sections in one revision without unrelated fields
PDF access failure preserves candidate information and offers recovery
Unsuccessful API response presents a retry action
Empty-data response shows an error instead of crashing
Navigation cancels the previous request
View-only user has no correction controls or private document link
Document permission blocks the preview request
Expanded list has all overview columns and identified education
Status filter preserves server query navigation
Pagination still requests the next page
Mobile list scrolls horizontally within its table container
List View/Review link navigates to the detail route
Mobile workspace stacks panels without page overflow
Grouped navigation contains six accessible links
Fit width keeps original PDF within its panel
PDF fit reacts to panel resizing and retains page aspect
Long history remains navigable and focused
Manual scrolling synchronizes the active group
Large skills and long summary fit mobile width
Mobile document follows the information panel without overlap
Empty optional relations retain all sections and review actions
limitations: Does not exercise a live authenticated Next server or database writes; API permission and revision services are tested separately.
